limitations: Confidence is self-assessed and uncalibrated; no attorney agreement or legal validation.
Agreement with a conservative annotation plus an explicit source concern is not resolution of that source ambiguity.
Definite-first cross-claim introduction, page/state identity, step-label term status, nested partitive grouping and distributive-head normalization remain bounded uncertainties where identified.
No reference, score denominator, previous result or retained pass changed.
criticismPrinciples: A prior actual nominal mention must be distinguished from a noun fabricated from a predicate. A same-clause unambiguous reference can warrant an overlay without repairing the first mention’s upstream antecedent sufficiency.
Represented functional relations need not be split at every verb solely to require duplicate pronoun nodes. Full exact connecting text and explicit participating entities remain required.
A step-level dependency relation and a term-level antecedent edge are different; preservation of one does not prove eligibility of an enumerator as a noun-phrase term.
Outer distributive determiners are not expressly resolved by cardinal/partitive examples; uncertainty is preferable to imposing a blanket rule.
